title: feat(test): compile subprocesses once per invocation

commit.messageHeadline: feat(test): compile subprocesses once per invocation
fix(test): resolve environment helper after suite relocation
fix(test): preserve errors while finalizing worker reports
fix(agents): keep provider discovery out of task presentation
fix(browser): keep cleanup imports out of agent tools
chore: refresh compiled-worker PR with main
style(ui): remove unused microphone picker variables
